title: Transpose Matrix
goal: Exchange matrix rows and columns while preserving every cell value.
strategy: Move each source cell (r,c) to destination (c,r). A rectangular matrix changes shape as well as orientation.

phasePurposes.inspect: Move each source cell (r,c) to destination (c,r). A rectangular matrix changes shape as well as orientation.
phasePurposes.update: Source row and column indices have exchanged roles.
phasePurposes.done: Source row and column indices have exchanged roles.

inputRules: Inputs are validated against this algorithm’s domain and the documented visualization size limits.
